description.value: Two fMRI experiments examined bottom-up and top-down neural activity during smoking-related attentional bias and cognitive control in control, ex-smoker and current smoker groups.

spans.text: Two experiments sought to identify the neural loci of bottom-up/top-down processing during fMRI.

description.value: A non-randomized, parallel-group study with control, ex-smoker and current smoker cohorts, including two experiments.

spans.text: Therefore, based on the concept of exaggerated bottom-up and compromised top-down neural processing in addiction, the current study was divided into two separate experiments.
A parallel Sensitivity Encoding (SENSE) approach ( ) with a reduction factor of 2 was utilised for all T1-weighted image acquisitions.

value: Smokers had lower BOLD activation than controls in the right precentral gyrus/BA4. This may indicate reduced neural functioning within motor cortical circuits in current nicotine addiction.

value: During successful STOP trials, smokers showed significantly lower BOLD activation than controls in prefrontal cortical regions, including the right anterior cingulate cortex and left dorsolateral prefrontal cortex. This may suggest insufficient neural activity within cognitive-control regions and relate to poorer response inhibition in nicotine addiction.

caption.value: Regions of activation during the neutral, evocative and drug conditions of the attentional bias paradigm in the control, ex-smoker and smoker groups. Shown are the regions for whole brain, small volume correction and region of interest analyses. Statistics shown are for 3 (Condition: neutral, evocative, and drug) × 3 (Group: control, ex-smoker, and smoker). The p values in parentheses indicate separate post hoc Bonferroni pair-wise comparison results between groups. Positive values for x , y and z Talairach co-ordinates denote, respectively, locations that are right, anterior and superior relative to the anterior commissure. Table abbreviations indicate: BA = Brodmann area; HS = hemisphere; Vol = activity cluster volume in microlitres; DLPFC = dorsolateral prefrontal cortex.
